title: Culturally Adaptive Explainable LLM Assessment for Multilingual Information Disorder: A Human-in-the-Loop Approach

bias_targets.methodology: Blinded A/B testing by native-speaking evaluators rating LLM-generated rationales on a Likert scale for cultural appropriateness, sensitivity to local cultural nuance, and avoidance of generic English-centric assumptions. Also evaluated using BERTScore to compare generated rationales against culturally-grounded human-written explanations.
Calculating alignment disparities (differences in Macro-F1 severity prediction scores) between the LLM's outputs and human annotators grouped by their first language (L1).
Calculating alignment disparities (differences in Macro-F1 severity prediction scores) between the LLM's outputs and human annotators stratified by gender.
